newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African thieves hit police headquarters.
newsitem.headline: S.African thieves hit police headquarters.

text.p: Criminals in South Africa have struck where it hurts most -- inside police headquarters.

Thieves stole a cash-dispensing machine from the fourth floor of the police head office in Pretoria, the heart of the country's security establishment, which has declared war on a wave of violent crime.
"The theft of this machine from the fourth floor has clearly revealed gaps in head-office security which must be urgently addressed," a police statement said.
The thieves got away with both the machine and its contents, about 22,000 rand ($4,800).
